The reading that would make that true on the source and false on the system is the one this face's own predecessor nearly published: searching the compiled artifact for a SOURCE-LEVEL identifier. tsc renames, so cachedPublicKey reads 0 in a bundle where the single-slot cache is present as wq -- an absence that reads as a fix.
mutant.expected: A search keyed to a source identifier must return 0 on the PRE-CHANGE artifact even though that artifact is single-slot -- i.e. the naive instrument must be shown to produce a false CLEAN before any verdict rests on it.
mutant.observed: It did: grep for cachedPublicKey on the pre-change deployed bundle returned 0 while the single-slot guard 'if(wq) return wq' was demonstrably present in the same bytes. The instrument was therefore discarded and every claim in S10D-AC1 and S10D-AC3 rests on the SECRET ID and the CACHE SHAPE read out of the minified call site instead. SECOND CONTROL ON A DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT, same session: the 31-function census first returned READERS=0 across the board because python cannot exec the .tools/aws bash shim on Windows (WinError 193) -- a summary line reading zero that meant the probe never ran, with the error count of 31 as the only tell. It was re-pointed at .tools/aws.cmd and POSITIVE-CONTROLLED before being trusted: a known reader HITs and a known non-reader does not. THIRD: the CloudTrail live-plane sweep threw ThrottlingException and ended with NextToken PRESENT, and its internal control -- a code-plane-PROVEN reader showing 0 reads in that partial window -- is what stopped a partial page being reported as an absence.

(d) Post-deploy health was read on two surfaces -- the log text and the CloudWatch Errors metric -- plus the Invocations count. declared_exclusions.item: A reader outside the five granting roles, or one that assembles the secret id at runtime
declared_exclusions.reason: Out of the census frame entirely. The code plane says who CAN read and never who DOES; a literal needle cannot see a dynamically-built id; and an inline policy on some other principal, a resource policy on the secret, an EC2/ECS task or a human are all outside the five-role scope the denominator is built on. Stated so a later reader does not take 4-of-31 as a claim about the whole world.
